sections.name: BacklinksGraph (part 2)
sections.title: Drawing dots, labels and clicks
sections.what: Draws each note as a dot with a short title under it. The selected note is larger and filled in the accent colour. Clicking a dot asks the parent to select that note.
sections.why: Likely reason: shows where the user is and lets them move between notes from the picture.
sections.watch_out: Titles are cut to 14 characters and three dots are always added, even to short titles.

summary: A small circle diagram that places each note as a dot and lets the user click a dot to select that note.
purpose: Gives a visual overview of the user's notes on the Notes page.
why: Likely reason: a quick visual map of the notes. The code does not state a goal beyond this.
how: Each note is placed around a circle. A line is drawn between every pair of notes. Each note is a dot with a shortened title beneath it, and the selected one is larger and highlighted. Clicking a dot tells the parent which note was chosen.
inputs: The list of notes, the id of the selected note, and a function to call when a note is clicked.
outputs: A drawn diagram, and a call back to the parent with the chosen note id.
risks: The lines do not follow real wiki links between notes. Every pair is connected, so the picture does not show real backlinks. With many notes the circle becomes crowded.
debug: If the diagram looks wrong, check the notes list passed in. If clicking does nothing, check that the parent passes the select function. Remember the lines are decorative, not a link map.
